title: Linux Kernel Architecture Deep Dive & Memory Subsystems
description:
A comprehensive deep dive into Linux kernel memory management. Topics covered:
- Physical vs Virtual Memory addressing
- The Page Allocator & Buddy System
- Slab, Slub and Slob caches
- Anonymous pages and Page Cache
- Zero-copy transfers and DMA buffers
- Mitigating OOM under memory pressure on embedded SoCs
